note: High-fidelity hero sprites for Nastavitve → Razvoj → Kakovost slik = Visoka (src/backgrounds.js). One entry per hero (the key is the game's hero id in src/game.js). manifest: the pack (docs/art-benchmarks/hero-sprites/README.md); its sheet comes from tools/art_hero_pack.py. states: which sequence the game shows for idle, running on the road (run), the moment the last enemy falls (win) and while the hero is down (down); only idle is required, a missing state keeps what the game did before. skills: per skill (1, 2, 3) the sequence for rank 1, 2, 3; a shorter list repeats its last entry for the higher ranks. A hero without an entry, or whose pack files are missing, keeps the sprite already in the game. Adding a hero is data only: its pack, its manifest, an entry here, then python3 tools/art_hero_pack.py <manifest> and python3 build.py.
